text:
emma: Quick heads-up — SparkFlow (seed, AI/ML infra) is asking for an expanded trial and a short-term committed discount. They want: 90-day trial, 1,000,000 gen tokens + $10k platform credit, and a 20% discount on the first 3 months of a Dedicated pool (monthly commit ~$12k). Asking for POC starting next Tue.
raj: looping in deal desk — need to know if this fits under the existing startup program or requires an exception. They were referred by partner Nebula.
olivia: @raj can you drop the ARR/commit details? For dealdesk we need: expected monthly commit, contract term, and whether they require any SLA.
emma: projected commit if they like POC: 3 months @ $12k/mo (can be bumped to $18k/mo after). No SLA requested for now, but they want SOC2 questionnaire answers before POC.
devex-mike: I can run pre-POC infra checks. Tech ask: they want private VPC option during POC to run some sensitive evals. That will need an on-prem or VPC-enabled Dedicated demo — is that covered under trial credits?
olivia: VPC for POC is allowed but typically charged. We can offset with credits if deal desk approves. Need legal signoff on any network exceptions.
legal-sam: flag — if we give Dedicated access for POC we need the standard DPA + onboarding security checklist filled. Also want to avoid making any IP assignment changes. If they request longer data retention, escalate.
li: from CS: they care about quick ramp — can run a minimal eval plan in 7 days if infra is provisioned. Suggest 30k of credits + 1M tokens is excessive; can we propose $10k credit + 500k tokens and the 20% discount?
emma: they pushed for 1M tokens because of long-form summarization runs. They're flexible on credits but want the 90-day window. 90-day trial is longer than our standard 30 days.
olivia: deal desk questions for approval: 1) Is 90-day trial permitted for seed-stage with partner referral? 2) Are we comfortable with 20% off for first 3 months only? 3) Any regulatory concerns for VPC demo? 4) Who owns risk if they spin up Dedicated during POC?
raj: answers: 1) partner referrals can get exceptions but need AM leader ok. 2) 20% starter discount is within promo band if limited to first 3 months and documented. 3) VPC demo — infra team to confirm. 4) Risk — customer on their account; ops to sign off on any infra credits.
olivia: can @legal-sam and @devex-mike + @li put thumbs on the proposed structure by EOD? I'll draft a one-off deal memo if we have consensus.
legal-sam: ok to proceed with draft. Require standard security questionnaire and DPA before any produce-level access. No bespoke IP clauses.
devex-mike: technical note: if we allow VPC POC we'll need 2 engineers on standby and an infra reservation. That adds ~$1.2k ops cost — suggest we include that as part of the $10k credit allocation (line-item: POC infra).
li: noted. CS can manage onboarding but needs a staging token bucket created and KV cache pre-warmed.
anna: *automated bot message* sales-bot: Deal desk request created — ticket #DD-2026-341. Link: https://redwood.internal/deals/DD-2026-341 :white_check_mark:
emma: thanks — I'll ping the SparkFlow AE to set expectations: offer $10k platform credit + 500k gen tokens for 90 days + 20% starter discount on first 3 months of commit, subject to deal desk + legal signoff and a DPA. If they insist on 1M tokens we can escalate to AM leader.
raj: please include the POC runbook and an explicit rollback plan in the deal memo. Also: include billing contact and billing cadence.
olivia: draft memo timeline: I will produce a 1-page memo and circulate for approvals within 4 hours. If everyone reacts :thumbsup: we can present to AM leader for final sign-off.
legal-sam: :thumbsup: from legal for draft route.
devex-mike: :thumbsup: ops confirmed resource ask.
li: :thumbsup: CS ok.
emma: pinging SparkFlow now. Will update thread after their response.
sparkflow-corp: *external message posted by Emma on behalf of SparkFlow* Hi team, appreciate the fast turnaround — we'd prefer 1M tokens but will take 500k if you can stretch the 90 days and the 20% starter discount. We'll sign the DPA ASAP.
emma: thanks — they accepted the compromise. Sending final memo to deal desk.
olivia: Received. I'll attach DD ticket and markup the memo. If AM leader approves by EOD we can issue credits and schedule POC for Tue.
raj: great — thanks everyone.
-- end thread --
